name: My Fair Link - Yousei Byakuya Monogatari
original_name: Myフェアりんく 妖精白夜物語
source:
One day hero finds a fairy falling unconscious in the forest. He takes her home. Fairy tells her story that she fell in love with a human and now wishes to gain a human form with magic. Hero wishes to cooperate and supply magical powers by providing sexual magic. This way their unusual cohabitation begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，男主发现一名精灵倒在森林里。他把她带回家。精灵讲述了自己的故事：她爱上了人类，现在希望用魔法获得人类形态。男主愿意合作，通过提供性魔法为她补充魔力。就这样，两人开始了不同寻常的同居生活。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
